reviews.author: June Lim
reviews.text:
The negative reviews here are completely justified. The staff’s attitude was awful, especially the girl at the counter. I asked a simple question about sizes and was met with an annoyed expression and an openly rude attitude.
The place also seemed understaffed, but that is absolutely not the customer’s responsibility. If she is unhappy working there, she should reconsider her job instead of taking her frustration out on paying customers. Customers do not owe staff any favors—basic politeness and professionalism are the bare minimum. This experience alone is enough to make me never return.

After experiencing it myself, I can understand why there are so many other reviews. The staff attitude was really unpleasant, especially the female staff member at the counter. I just asked about the size, but they responded with an annoyed look and an indifferent attitude.
Although it seemed like there was a lack of manpower, there was no reason for customers to have to endure that inconvenience. If you don't want to do this job, it's better to quit the job instead of taking out your anger on the customer. I have no intention of visiting again as this place lacks even basic manners.

reviews.author: Yechan Yang
reviews.text: After ordering online, I selected store pickup and went to Dongdaemun to receive the product. I received the product, but the box looked like that, so I asked for a replacement box, and they said, "If you don't like it, refund it." It's absurd and embarrassing. Isn’t it the business’s fault for not providing the right product? Is it normal to talk like that to a customer who came a long way? The employees seem to know that they don't serve customers properly, so they put stickers on their name tags so I can't even recognize their names. Since it's Dongdaemun, there are a lot of foreign customers, but I'm worried that they're just ruining the country's prestige by providing customer service that goes beyond common sense. This is my first time using ABC Mart and I don't think I'll ever use it again.
